RAG By The Numbers

RAG cut hallucinated answers by 45% in our internal evaluation over 2026-05-12.

Throughput dropped from 320 requests/second to 210 requests/second under load, a 34% reduction. The vector index occupied 4.2 GB on disk and required 95 °C cooling under sustained queries.

Licensing costs ranged from $99 to €240 per developer seat across the 12 month evaluation.

By 2026 we expect 1,200,000 monthly retrievals and a 3.14 latency budget per query.
